review: I've been using this budgeting app for a while and overall it's decent. However, I was completely caught off guard when I opened it one morning and all my saved categories had vanished overnight. No warning, no notification, nothing. It wasn't a crash or a bug per se, just gone. I had to re-enter everything manually. Hopefully this doesn't happen again.
sentence: I was completely caught off guard when I opened it one morning and all my saved categories had vanished overnight.

review: Great fitness tracking app with lots of features. I was surprised to find that after completing a 30-day workout streak, the app simply reset my progress counter without any celebration or acknowledgment. I expected at least a badge or a congratulatory message. Feels a bit anticlimactic after working so hard.
sentence: I was surprised to find that after completing a 30-day workout streak, the app simply reset my progress counter without any celebration or acknowledgment.

review: The recipe app is wonderful for discovering new meals. One thing that caught me off guard is that it asked me to write a review after I had only opened the app for the first time and hadn't even tried a single recipe yet. How am I supposed to review something I just downloaded? Give me at least a week first.
sentence: One thing that caught me off guard is that it asked me to write a review after I had only opened the app for the first time and hadn't even tried a single recipe yet.

review: This language learning app is generally very helpful. But I was shocked when I noticed that the app was tracking my microphone even when running in the background, completely unrelated to any active lesson. I didn't expect that at all and it made me uncomfortable about my privacy.
sentence: I was shocked when I noticed that the app was tracking my microphone even when running in the background, completely unrelated to any active lesson.

review: Decent photo editing app with good tools. However, I was puzzled to discover that exporting a photo in high resolution suddenly counts against a daily limit I never knew existed. sentence: I was puzzled to discover that exporting a photo in high resolution suddenly counts against a daily limit I never knew existed.

review: I really enjoy using this meditation app. The guided sessions are calming and well-structured. This is not exactly what I expected from an app designed to help me sleep better.
sentence: I was taken aback when the app sent me a push notification at 3am, which obviously woke me up.

review: This travel planning app is very handy for organizing trips.
